import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem fixed_point_locus_has_least
    (f : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    ∃ x : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      f x = x ∧ ∀ y : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f y = y → x ≤ y := by
  classical
  let a : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩⟩
  let b : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨1, ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩⟩
  let g : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → ℝ := fun x => (f x : ℝ) - (x : ℝ)
  
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    have h₁ : Continuous (fun x : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 => (f x : ℝ)) :=
      continuous_subtype_val.comp hf
    exact h₁.sub continuous_subtype_val
  
  have hga : 0 ≤ g a := by
    have hmem : (f a : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := (f a).property
    have hlow : 0 ≤ (f a : ℝ) := (Set.mem_Icc.mp hmem).1
    simpa [g, a] using hlow
  
  have hgb : g b ≤ 0 := by
    have hmem : (f b : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := (f b).property
    have hupp : (f b : ℝ) ≤ 1 := (Set.mem_Icc.mp hmem).2
    have h : (f b : ℝ) - 1 ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr hupp
    simpa [g, b] using h
  
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.range g :=
    mem_range_of_exists_le_of_exists_ge hg ⟨b, hgb⟩ ⟨a, hga⟩
  
  have hfixed : ∃ x : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f x = x := by
    rcases hzero with ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hreal : (f x : ℝ) = (x : ℝ) := by
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      simpa [g] using hx
    exact ⟨x, Subtype.ext hreal⟩
  
  let A : Set (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := {x | f x = x}
  
  have hA_closed : IsClosed A := by
    have hzero_closed : IsClosed (g ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℝ)) :=
      isClosed_singleton.preimage hg
    have hA_eq : A = g ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hreal : (f x : ℝ) = (x : ℝ) :=
          congrArg Subtype.val hx
        simpa [g, sub_eq_zero] using hreal
      · intro hx
        have hreal : (f x : ℝ) = (x : ℝ) := by
          apply sub_eq_zero.mp
          simpa [g] using hx
        simpa [A] using Subtype.ext hreal
    rw [hA_eq]
    exact hzero_closed
  
  have hA_nonempty : A.Nonempty := by
    rcases hfixed with ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, by simpa [A] using hx⟩
  
  have hI_compact : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) := by
    exact (isCompact_iff_isCompact_univ
      (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).mp isCompact_Icc
  
  have hA_compact : IsCompact A :=
    hI_compact.of_isClosed_subset hA_closed (Set.subset_univ A)
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hA_compact.exists_isLeast hA_nonempty

    fun y hy => hx.2 (by simpa [A] using hy)⟩

    norm_num
  
  have him :=

  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzg⟩ := him

    apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp [g] at hzg
    linarith
  
  let s : Set (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := {x | f x = x}
  
  have hsclosed : IsClosed s := by
    exact isClosed_eq hf continuous_id

    hsclosed.isCompact

    ⟨z, hzfix⟩
